newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Gengold studying 3 mln oz deep gold mine.
newsitem.headline: Gengold studying 3 mln oz deep gold mine.

text.p: Gengold Ltd said on Monday that its Evander Gold Mines Ltd unit was assessing exploitation of three million ounces of recoverable gold in the Poplar project area at a cost of around 120 million rand.

Three independent pre-feasibility studies into the project suggested that between three and five km of reef development could be secured via a six metre diameter, 800 metre deep vertical shaft wtihin three to 3-1/2 years.
Evander would commission detailed investigations shortly, Gengold said in a statement accompanying first quarter results.
